blocking_findings.finding: O02 and O03 exceeded the frozen 30-call ceiling. The reports and source snapshots are preserved and neither case was retried, but the layer fails the frozen host contract.

O01 uses secondary reporting for a load-bearing Windows platform-coverage claim although the case requires first-party product documentation and original adoption data. O03 relies on multiple secondary market and transcript sources for decision-bearing valuation and attribution claims although the case calls for SEC, IR, customer or exchange originals and reproducible market data.

O03 connects aggregate company backlog, revenue, operating profit and cash flow into a company-level order-to-cash chain without proving that the same order cohort or the liquid-cooling product line carries that lineage. Its later NOT_EVALUABLE boundary for liquid-cooling P&L is correct, but the earlier aggregate chain remains stronger than the evidence.
O03 stores 41 source files, including many duplicate text transforms and secondary pages, instead of one canonical snapshot per upstream source with marked derivatives only where necessary.
